 Tyrese Maxey shares what he said to VJ Edgecombe just before his clutch triple vs Hornets
 Originally posted on
 HITC 
  | 
 By Shamanth Jayaram
  | 
 Last updated Nov 1, 2026 3:46 AM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 VJ Edgecombe pulled off a clutch three-pointer for the second game running to help the Philadelphia 76ers go 6-1. 
 The 21-year-old has been having a fine season for the Sixers, but one of his final actions in each of his last two games is what has got everyone talking. 
 Edgecombe scored a clutch triple against the Knicks in the NBA Cup before doing the exact same thing against the Hornets on Halloween night. 
 However, just before he took the shot, he had a different plan.
 Tyrese Maxey told VJ Edgecombe not to pass him the ball before his clutch triple
 Tyrese Maxey is arguably the Philadelphia 76ers’ best player. 
 The 25-year-old has been amazing for the Sixers since the start of the season, and he was once again the star of the show against the Hornets. 
 Maxey scored 38 points and recorded four assists and four rebounds in what was a phenomenal overall performance at the Spectrum Center.
 That is probably why Edgecombe, when he got the ball in the final minute of the game, looked to pass it to Maxey so that he could score more points for the team. 
 But Maxey was having none of that.
 "This group some fighters man."
Tyrese Maxey on another Sixers comeback victory. | @FultonBank pic.twitter.com/mZTo0K5a5c 
— NBC Sports Philadelphia (@NBCSPhilly) November 1, 2026 
 He said on NBCS Philly after the game: “I told him, he looked at me to pass me the ball. I said: ‘Don’t pass me the ball. That’s what you do. You always hit big shots like this.’
 “He did it again.”
 Edgecombe is still only 21, so we should not blame him for looking to his more experienced teammates late in the games in crunch situations. 
 However, as his two late three-pointers in back-to-back games have shown, he should believe in himself a lot more and take those shots irrespective of the game state.
